strategies.overview:
(Flying)

Often overshadowed by other speed control options such as Choice Scarf Enamorus and Landorus-T as well as wallbreakers like Landorus and Dragonite, it tends to be difficult to slot Galarian Zapdos into the average Flying team. However, Galarian Zapdos is incredible in the Steel and Dark matchups; doesn't fear Aqua Jet from Urshifu-R, unlike the Landorus formes; and, in contrast to Enamorus, takes neutral damage from Stealth Rock while having access to a pivoting move in U-turn.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

(Flying)

Choiced Attacker Galarian Zapdos may opt for Thunderous Kick over Close Combat to avoid the stat drops while also pressuring walls with a Defense drop; however, Close Combat is significantly more powerful and allows it to OHKO Ting-Lu and Archaludon with a Choice Band.

movesets.name: Choiced Attacker (Flying)
movesets.description:
Galarian Zapdos possesses a great STAB combination, reliable Speed tier, and great ability in Defiant, allowing it to threaten Dark and Steel teams. Close Combat targets Dark- and Steel-types such as Hydreigon, Hisuian Goodra, and Heatran. Brave Bird hits Fighting-resistant and immune threats like Amoonguss, Iron Valiant, and Brambleghast. Knock Off allows Galarian Zapdos to hit Gholdengo as well as other Ghost-types to minimize Brave Bird's recoil damage over time. U-turn allows it to predict and pivot out of switch-ins like Alomomola and Slowbro, preserving momentum and leaving behind decent chip damage. A Choice Scarf enables Galarian Zapdos to outpace and remove threats such as the Ogerpon formes, Flutter Mane, Greninja, and bulky Volcarona after a Quiver Dance; meanwhile, a Choice Band allows it to OHKO Ting-Lu and Archaludon after minor chip damage as well as 2HKO Mandibuzz, Corviknight, and Skarmory with Close Combat and Toxapex with Brave Bird.

Specially defensive Corviknight is heavily cherished as a switch-in to opposing Fairy-types like Enamorus and Flutter Mane. It also provides Defog support, removing Stealth Rock to minimize chip damage on Galarian Zapdos, which is especially important with the use of Brave Bird. In return, Galarian Zapdos threatens Hisuian Samurott, Magnezone, and especially Bisharp, which can capitalize off Corviknight's Defog via Defiant. Gliscor provides an essential Electric-type immunity, combating Raging Bolt and Iron Hands while providing entry hazards to ease Galarian Zapdos's wallbreaking. Skarmory walls physical attackers like Meowscarada and Dragonite while also providing Spikes and phazing via Whirlwind to wear down threats such as Great Tusk, physical variants of Garchomp, and Archaludon lacking Thunderbolt. Galarian Zapdos is appreciated by both Gliscor and Skarmory, as it can deter Defog users from clearing their entry hazards with Defiant. Furthermore, Galarian Zapdos removes Ice-types like Kyurem and Choice-locked Mamoswine for Gliscor as well as Fire-types such as Hisuian Arcanine, Heatran, and Volcarona for Skarmory. Landorus removes threats like Pecharunt, Zapdos, and Moltres via Earth Power and Rock Slide; using a Choice Scarf, (AC) it threatens Choice Specs Greninja and Choice Band Meowscarada as well. It values Galarian Zapdos's ability to OHKO Sinistcha, Assault Vest Gallade, and Araquanid. Assault Vest Tornadus-T is a great bulky pivot that provides utility in Knock Off and U-turn, enabling Galarian Zapdos's wallbreaking throughout the match. Tornadus-T appreciates Galarian Zapdos threatening the aforementioned Steel-types as well as Kyurem. Dragon Dance Gyarados is capable of cleaning up late-game once Galarian Zapdos has severely weakened defensive backbones, particularly Ground, as it doesn't fear Mamoswine's Ice Shard and can typically set up freely once Ting-Lu has been removed. Articuno provides a great Ice-type neutrality that allows it to handle Alolan Ninetales's and Greninja's Ice-type coverage. Moltres provides an answer to threatening wallbreakers like Ogerpon-H and Choice Band Iron Valiant.

movesets.name: Choice Band (Fighting)
movesets.description:
Galarian Zapdos makes for a great asset to Fighting teams by virtue of its part Flying typing, easing the Fighting, Ground, and Grass matchups. Brave Bird breaks through troublesome physical walls that Fighting teams struggle with such as Amoonguss, Sinistcha, and Zamazenta, while Close Combat targets Corviknight and Skarmory. Knock Off grants coverage against Ghost- and Psychic-types like Gholdengo and Iron Crown and removes items such as Black Sludge from Toxapex and Tentacruel. Alternatively, Drill Peck is a weaker but safer option against targets like Urshifu-R and Rillaboom, as it doesn't come with recoil damage. However, using it comes with the downside of not having coverage against targets that its teammates can struggle with. U-turn allows Galarian Zapdos to act as a pivot to bring a teammate in safely while OHKOing Hoopa-U.

Choice Scarf users such as Iron Valiant and Sneasler pair well with Galarian Zapdos, as the two of them can deal with Dragon- and Fairy-types that threaten it. Iron Valiant handles the likes of Dragapult, Walking Wake, and Latias, while Sneasler deals with opposing Iron Valiant and Enamorus. In return, they appreciate Galarian Zapdos OHKOing Gholdengo with Knock Off and bringing them in with U-turn. Great Tusk makes for another great teammate, setting up Stealth Rock to support Galarian Zapdos's wallbreaking potential, serving as an asset against Fire teams thanks to Protosynthesis helping it under sun, and taking on the likes of Heatran, Ceruledge, and Hisuian Arcanine thanks to its bulk; it also provides hazard removal with Rapid Spin and an Electric immunity. Great Tusk also appreciates Galarian Zapdos handling Grass-types like Hydrapple and Amoonguss for it. Iron Hands, with its great special bulk, takes on Greninja and Flutter Mane while also forming a VoltTurn core with Galarian Zapdos, and Galarian Zapdos returns the favor by handling Great Tusk for it. Choice Scarf Keldeo threatens faster Fire- and Ground-types that can threaten Galarian Zapdos such as Choice Specs Iron Moth and Choice Scarf Landorus. Breloom immobilizes a threatening foe with Spore and deals with bulky Water-types such as Primarina and physically defensive Rotom-W. Lastly, Galarian Zapdos's wallbreaking opens up sweeping opportunities from late-game cleaners such as Hisuian Lilligant and Choice Band Zamazenta.

movesets.name: Choice Band
movesets.description: Choice Band Galarian Zapdos is an excellent wallbreaker whose power is further boosted by Sword of Ruin. Boasting two powerful STAB moves with excellent neutral coverage in Close Combat and Brave Bird, Galarian Zapdos can most notably 2HKO Deoxys-D and Intimidate Corviknight. Knock Off beats Gholdengo and hinders switch-ins like Fluffy Corviknight and defensive Zapdos, while U-turn allows for pivoting against Fluffy users. Adamant is the preferred nature for better odds to 2HKO Intimidate Corviknight, while Jolly allows Galarian Zapdos to Speed tie with the plethora of base 100 Speed Pokemon, at the cost of only 3HKOing Intimidate Corviknight. Galarian Zapdos is a relatively slow and frail wallbreaker and is forced out by offensive threats such as Azelf and Chien-Pao, so it appreciates being brought in by pivots such as Azelf and Iron Moth; in return, it can threaten special walls like Swampert and Hisuian Goodra for them. Slow pivots like Corviknight and Swampert are also appreciated, as they can take a hit for it and pivot it in safely, with the former also providing entry hazard control, extending Galarian Zapdos's longevity. Galarian Zapdos struggles against Fluffy walls such as Corviknight, so Fire-types such as Ceruledge and Iron Moth make for great teammates. Stealth Rock setters such as Great Tusk and Deoxys-D are also good teammates, allowing Galarian Zapdos to always 2HKO Intimidate Corviknight; in return, it can threaten opposing Great Tusk, preventing it from removing entry hazards. Galarian Zapdos's wallbreaking prowess is further empowered when paired with other offensive threats such as Barraskewda and Roaring Moon, as they can wear down shared checks like Fluffy Corviknight.

movesets.name: Magic Guard
movesets.description: Galarian Zapdos is a threatening physical wallbreaker thanks to its high base Attack and powerful STAB moves in Brave Bird and Thunderous Kick. Magic Guard prevents chip damage from Stealth Rock as well as Rocky Helmet, which is commonly used by Corviknight and Skarmory. Thunderous Kick is used because the Defense drop it causes allows Galarian Zapdos to KO Pokemon like RegenVest Iron Hands with Brave Bird afterwards. Knock Off allows Galarian Zapdos to threaten switch-ins such as Gholdengo and Deoxys-D while OHKOing Iron Boulder. Galarian Zapdos can use U-turn to function as an offensive pivot as well as to switch out on uncomfortable matchups such as Corviknight, Skarmory, and Fluffy Mandibuzz, while Close Combat can be used as a second STAB option that, unlike Thunderous Kick, OHKOes Archaludon and has a very high chance to OHKO specially defensive Garganacl and Chansey. Galarian Zapdos struggles against physical walls such as Gholdengo, Corviknight, and Skarmory; special attacking wallbreakers like Sandy Shocks, Iron Moth, and Heatran are heavily appreciated, since they are able to counter them. Galarian Zapdos is also threatened by fast foes such as Dragonite, Iron Boulder, and Deoxys-S. Teammates like defensive Gholdengo and Fluffy Corviknight are appreciated to counter both Dragonite and Iron Boulder, while special walls like RegenVest Manaphy and Swampert can check Deoxys-S.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 4 onwards

Price Range: 10-11 points

Overview: Galarian Zapdos is a strong wallbreaker capable of dismantling defensive cores. Its Fighting- and Flying-type STAB moves have nearly perfect offensive synergy, which means very few Pokemon can safely switch in to its full toolkit. However, it is prone to wearing itself down during games with Brave Bird recoil damage combined with damage from sources such as Stealth Rock and Rocky Helmet, which significantly dampens its staying power during a game. Furthermore, Galarian Zapdos's average Speed makes it prone to getting offensively overwhelmed by more aggressive teams, and it struggles to get around its checks due to its limited movepool outside of its STAB moves, especially since it is often Choice locked.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Wallbreaker: Galarian Zapdos uses its strong STAB moves and great offensive typing to be an effective wallbreaker, often equipped with a Choice Band to further enhance its damage output.

Offensive Pivot: When equipped with a Choice Scarf, Galarian Zapdos can outspeed other fast wallbreakers and setup sweepers, allowing it to revenge kill or pivot around them.

Setup Sweeper: Galarian Zapdos can sometimes run setup sets with Bulk Up to break through teams and Agility or Trailblaze to outspeed faster threats. However, these sets often struggle with longevity, as its strongest STAB moves, Close Combat and Brave Bird, allow it to quickly get worn down.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Close Combat, Brave Bird, Thunderous Kick, Drill Peck

Setup Moves: Bulk Up, Agility, Trailblaze

Utility Moves: U-turn, Taunt, Substitute

Coverage: Knock Off, Stomping Tantrum

Niche Moves

Rest + Sleep Talk: Because Galarian Zapdos often only needs its STAB moves to break through opposing defensive cores and is prone to wearing itself down with defensive stat drops and recoil damage, the combination of Rest and Sleep Talk can allow it to remain healthy for longer in a match.

Acrobatics: Sets that utilize a consumable item can use Acrobatics for a strong recoil-free Flying-type move.

Endure: Galarian Zapdos can make use of Reversal and Endeavor if left at low HP with Endure.

Brick Break: Brick Break is useful against opposing drafts featuring dual screens setters like Klefki and Alolan Ninetales.

Common Items

Choice Band: Galarian Zapdos's combination of solid Attack and Speed stats and access to strong STAB moves and U-turn make makes it an even more effective wallbreaker with Choice Band.

Choice Scarf: Galarian Zapdos can use Choice Scarf to outrun faster wallbreakers and some setup sweepers, making it a solid revenge killer.

Niche Items

Damage-boosting Items: Sets that want damage amplification without a Choice lock can make use of items such as Life Orb, Black Belt, and Expert Belt.

Eject Pack: Galarian Zapdos can use Eject Pack in conjunction with Close Combat to simultaneously dish out major damage and pivot out.

Lum Berry: Galarian Zapdos's susceptibility to burn and paralysis makes Lum Berry useful to it.

Sitrus Berry: Setup-based sets can use Sitrus Berry as one-time recovery that also boosts Acrobatics upon its consumption.

Chesto Berry: Chesto Berry can be used with Rest on setup-based sets to heal damage taken while setting up while also boosting Acrobatics after use.

Tera

Galarian Zapdos isn't the best choice for a Tera Captain because it is satisfied with its typing and offensive coverage. If chosen as a Tera Captain, it most often uses Tera Flying or Fighting to further boost its STAB moves. Alternatively, it could use Tera Dark to boost the power of Knock Off and gain an immunity to Psychic, or Tera Steel to neutralize its weakness to Fairy, Psychic, and Ice; the defensive benefits from both of these types also make setup sets more effective.

Draft Strategy

Galarian Zapdos should be added to teams desiring a mid-tier wallbreaker, and it benefits from support that allows it to enter the field as often as possible to break down defensive cores.

Entry Hazards: Galarian Zapdos is especially effective at forcing switches, which makes hazard support from Pokemon like Ting-Lu and Hisuian Samurott particularly useful. Defiant also allows Galarian Zapdos to punish opposing Defog usage.

Slow Momentum: Due to Galarian Zapdos's propensity to wear itself down over the course of a game, it appreciates safe entry onto the field via slow pivots such as both Slowking formes, which are further useful due to the Future Sight support they provide.

Cleaners: Because it is best situated as a wallbreaker, Galarian Zapdos appreciates having faster teammates capable of cleaning up games, such as Meowscarada and Weavile.

Entry Hazard Removal: Although Galarian Zapdos is only vulnerable to Stealth Rock, due to its general vulnerability to chip damage, it appreciates partners that can remove hazards such as Iron Treads and Terapagos.

Checks and Counters

Faster Pokemon: Galarian Zapdos's average Speed leaves it prone to being revenge killed by faster Pokemon such as Tornadus-T, Greninja, and Latios. It can also be picked off by strong priority users such as Mamoswine and Scizor.

Fighting- and Flying-resistant Pokemon: Although very few Pokemon can effectively deal with Galarian Zapdos's STAB combination, bulky Pokemon that can pivot in on one of its STAB moves such as Galarian Slowking and Uxie can effectively scout what Galarian Zapdos wants to do.

Contact Effects: Because all of Galarian Zapdos's moves make contact, it is vulnerable to negative contact effects including Static, Flame Body, and Rocky Helmet. Zapdos in particular is problematic, as it resists Galarian Zapdos's STAB combination and threatens to paralyze it with Static, and it's only truly harmed by losing its Heavy-Duty Boots to Knock Off.

Status: Being afflicted with burn or paralysis significantly reduces Galarian Zapdos's wallbreaking capabilities.

movesets.name: Choice Scarf (Fighting)
movesets.description: Galarian Zapdos is an excellent Choice Scarf user on Fighting teams thanks to its unique set of traits within the type. Steel Wing notably OHKOes a huge threat to these teams in Mega Diancie while also nailing Tapu Lele and Alolan Ninetales. Knock Off targets Psychic- and Ghost-types like Galarian Slowking, Jirachi, and Galarian Corsola. Finally, U-turn can bring in teammates while getting chip damage on the foe as well as switching Galarian Zapdos out of bad matchups like Slowbro and Gholdengo. Iron Valiant equipped with Choice Specs or a Z-Crystal is able to break through Pokemon that wall Galarian Zapdos such as Kyurem, Latias, Raging Bolt, and Tapu Koko. Mega Gallade is another great teammate for Galarian Zapdos, as it acts as a great setup sweeper and wallbreaker with Swords Dance and greatly improves the Poison matchup. Iron Hands also pairs well, as it has a neutrality to Flying and can hit Flying-types with Ice Punch or Thunder Punch and has access to a slow Volt Switch that can bring it in safely. Iron Hands's great bulk also allows it to take on otherwise problematic threats like Enamorus-T, Tornadus-T, and Pelipper. Great Tusk is a nice support Pokemon for Galarian Zapdos, as it provides an Electric-immunity as well as Rapid Spin and Stealth Rock support, helping Galarian Zapdos get more KOs. It's also a great physical wall and can take out threats such as Iron Hands and Zeraora. In return, Galarian Zapdos handles Grass-types like Ogerpon-W, Tapu Bulu, and Mega Venusaur for it. Finally, Hisuian Lilligant can be a good team member for Galarian Zapdos, as it provides sleep support, taking counters to Galarian Zapdos out of the picture and easing the Water and Ground matchups. Hisuian Lilligant and Galarian Zapdos also make a great late-game cleaning duo.
